import json,glob,csv
files=sorted(glob.glob('predictions/*.json'))
latest={}
for f in files:

        latest[e['question_id']]=e['outcomes']
rows={r['qid']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('market.csv'))}
res=set()
hi=[(max(v.values()),k,max(v,key=v.get)) for k,v in latest.items()]
hi.sort(reverse=True)
n=0
for p,q,o in hi:
    if p<0.4: break
    t=rows[q]['title'][:88] if q in rows else '?'
    d=rows[q]['resolution_date'][:10]
    if d < '2026-04-30': continue
    n+=1
    print(round(p,2), d, q, o[:26].ljust(26), t)
print('count',n)
"
